## Executive Overview
Jacob Ayokunle is a technology founder, former CTO, and agentic systems architect with 10+ years of proven experience building, operating, and scaling complex software platforms across fintech, e-commerce, AI automation, and green energy compliance.

In the modern AI-native era, Jacob specializes in **Agentic Engineering**: designing and supervising autonomous agentic loops, multi-agent swarms (LangGraph, MCP), reasoning-model workflows across major providers, and resilient self-healing production systems.

## Availability
- Open to strategic and technical advisory engagements.
- Open to fractional CTO engagements.
- Open to co-building in AI and fintech.
- Available for speaking on agentic systems.
- Currently Senior Software Engineer at Atmen Solutions GmbH (Munich).

## Flagship Ventures & Products

### 1. Sprachflow (https://sprachflow.app)
- **Role**: Founder & Lead Architect
- **Mission**: Next-generation AI-powered preparation platform for the German TELC B1 language certification.
- **Key Achievement**: Built and operated with AI-agent workflows for content generation, grading, and QA — with human review on the exam-critical paths; grown organically to over **5,000 exam practices monthly** from real learners.
- **Core Technology**:
  - LLM agent workflows generating dynamic, non-repetitive exam papers adhering strictly to TELC B1 guidelines.
  - Automated speech and writing evaluation providing instantaneous, actionable pedagogical feedback.
  - Next.js, TypeScript, Python/FastAPI, Vector search, and LLM inference.

### 2. GetBlitz (https://getblitz.io / https://github.com/getblitz-io/getblitz)
- **Role**: Founder & Creator (2025 – Present)
- **Mission**: Open-source, self-hosted SEPA Instant payment gateway designed for European businesses and developers.
- **Key Features**:
  - Zero transaction fees: Direct bank-to-bank settlement in under 10 seconds across all 36 SEPA countries.
  - Complete data sovereignty & GDPR-native: Transaction data remains on merchant infrastructure.
  - Real-time WebSockets: Instant payment confirmation pushing live events to applications.
  - Ecosystem: Official WooCommerce plugin, TypeScript/JavaScript client SDK, pluggable bank providers (Qonto, Revolut Business, Wise).
  - License: MIT Open Source.

### 3. Indicina Inc (https://indicina.co / Remote Technology GmbH)
- **Role**: Former CTO & Co-Founder (Jan 2022 – Dec 2024)
- **Key Wins**:
  - Built custom Machine Learning credit scoring models that reduced Non-Performing Loans (NPLs) by 20% for top-tier retail banks.
  - Managed multiple cross-functional engineering teams (Software Engineers, QA, Product Managers, Product Designers, SREs).
  - Designed B2B2C SaaS digital lending infrastructure and loan eligibility systems using Golang, Next.js, Express, React, MySQL, RabbitMQ, Redis, Kubernetes, AWS.
  - Led company-wide compliance and security audits to achieve PCI-DSS and NDPR certifications for 3 consecutive years.

### 4. Antler (Munich, Germany — Jan 2025 – May 2025)
- **Role**: Founder in Residence
- **Focus**: Technical design and hands-on implementation of an agentic AI automation platform for insurance brokers using FastAPI (Python), Next.js (TypeScript), open-weight reasoning models, LangChain, PostgreSQL, and GCP.

### 5. Atmen Solutions GmbH (Munich, Germany — Jul 2025 – Present)
- **Role**: Senior Software Engineer
- **Focus**: Enterprise RegTech and carbon accounting platform for clean fuels (hydrogen, biomethane, RFNBO, RED II/III).
- **Key Contributions**:
  - Designed a dynamically configurable multi-stage emissions tracking system, enabling industrial operators to continuously calculate and audit carbon intensity across complex multi-step production sites.
  - Built an AI-driven document intelligence pipeline that ingests and reconciles Proof of Sustainability (PoS) certificates, trade documents, and feedstock records to automate mass-balance carbon accounting.
  - Provide direct client technical advisory and solutions support, ensuring enterprise renewable fuel producers and traders achieve seamless platform onboarding and audit readiness.

## Earlier Track Record & Leadership

### EQS Group (Munich, Germany — 2021)
- **Role**: Software Engineering Manager
- Led cross-functional teams developing investor relations platforms improving client relationship efficiency by 10%.
- Migrated hosting infrastructure from Docker Swarm to Kubernetes, reducing deployment time by 20%.
- Implemented automated CI/CD via GitLab CI, shortening deployment cycle times by 30%.

### Westwing Group AG (Munich, Germany — 2018–2020)
- **Role**: Senior Software Engineer
- Led technical overhaul of the warehouse returns platform, boosting warehouse inbound efficiency by 100%.
- Designed and implemented warehouse mapping algorithms, reducing item pick time by 12%.
- Led frontend migration from Ember.js to React.js, decreasing page load times by 40%.

### Konga Online Shopping Limited (2015–2018)
- **Role**: Software Engineering Manager (Payment) & Senior Software Engineer
- Led development and rollout of KongaPay core wallet and payment gateway processing over ₦25,000,000 in daily transactions (≈ €60k+/day at the time).
- Migrated critical infrastructure from AWS to GCP, resulting in a 30% reduction in cloud operating expenditure.
- Built marketplace integrations connecting Mirakl and Magento for 1,000+ commercial merchants.

- **Backend & Distributed Systems**: Golang, Python, TypeScript / Node.js, PHP, Java, FastAPI, Echo, NestJS, Express, Microservices, Event-driven architecture (RabbitMQ, Redis), REST, GraphQL, WebSockets.
